text: The pacing feels slow during the first act.
The final act feels rushed and unsatisfying.
The lead actor delivers a convincing and emotionally grounded performance.
Supporting actors have natural chemistry and lively dialogue.
The visuals use vivid colors and careful lighting.
The sound mix is uneven, making important dialogue hard to hear.
The script includes predictable twists and flat characters.
The final scene provides an unexpectedly touching moment.
The soundtrack is memorable and supports the atmosphere.
The pacing becomes repetitive during the middle section.
The editing is tight and helps create suspense.
Several side characters are introduced without development.
Reviewers praise the careful production design.
The dialogue sometimes sounds unnatural and overly formal.
The comedy includes several clever jokes.
Some jokes are repeated too often to stay funny.
The documentary presents interviews with clear historical context.
The narration moves too quickly through key dates.
The visual style is minimalist and striking.
